items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds 'Yes, nice to be here.'

ctx.x: Rick was interviewed via Zoom on November 22, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and we are going across the pond today, which technology-wise is pretty amazing. I’m speaking with Rick Margitza who is in Paris, is that correct?
